title: Slug Generator
h1: Slug Generator — Create Clean URL Slugs from Any Text
seoTitle: Free Slug Generator — Convert Text to URL-Friendly Slugs
description: Turn titles and phrases into clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs. Removes special characters, lowercases text, and replaces spaces with hyphens. Runs entirely in your browser.
intro: Paste any text and instantly get a clean URL slug ready for blog posts, product pages, or any SEO-friendly link. No data leaves your device.
blurb: Convert text into clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs in one click.

controls.label: Text
controls.placeholder: Paste your title or phrase here...

howItWorks: Paste or type the text you want to turn into a slug.
Choose hyphen or underscore as the separator.
Click Generate slug. Special characters are removed and spaces become separators.
examples: Blog post title: How to Bake the Perfect Cake → how-to-bake-the-perfect-cake
Product name: Super Widget Pro 2026 → super-widget-pro-2026
With accents: Café & Restaurant Menu → cafe-restaurant-menu

faq.a: A slug is the part of a web address that identifies a page in a readable way, usually derived from the page title.
No. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your text never leaves your device.
Accents are simplified, punctuation and symbols are removed, and multiple spaces or separators are collapsed into one.
